documents.t: Worked examples — executed notebooks rendered as pages (refreshed weekly against the live APIs): Quickstart

sportsdataverse.basketball.nbl_au — 22 endpoints. Note: Unofficial: the JSON proxy behind nbl.com.au (not an API the NBL documents or supports). The terms of use were not reviewed; payloads are not redistributed as release assets. Note: Gated by a referer, not a key: every request carries Origin / Referer set to nbl.com.au (the runtime sends them); without them the host answers 403 MISSING_API_KEY, which is raised as AssetFetchError. Note: Fills a hole in ESPN: ESPN's nbl feed has box scores but no plays for the 2025-26 NBL season (the stats provider changed from Genius Sports to Sportradar DataCore that year). nbl_rosetta_match_pbp has the full event log with shot x/y for 2025-26 and, in the same shape, back to 2011-12 (WNBL about 2014-15). Matches from 1979 have box scores only. Note: One host serves three organisations; pass org='nbl' (default), 'wnbl' or 'nbl1'. NBL1 is the second tier (men's and women's conferences, calendar-year seasons). Note: Season = the END year (2026 = 2025-26) everywhere. Rosetta's own year is the START year for the NBL and WNBL from 1998-99 and a calendar year for NBL1 and the 1979-1997 winter seasons; the runtime maps it. Year 1998 holds two seasons (calendar 1998 and 1998-99). Note: Ids: id columns are DataCore ids (UUID v1; join on them), rosetta_id Rosetta's own. match_id is the DataCore fixture id every match route is keyed on. Note: Unknown ids, orgs and types answer 200 with no rows (NoDataError). Rosetta caches a body per path and serves it whatever the query string, so a page cut by someone else's limit is refused (AssetFetchError); retry after the cache entry expires.

documents.t: One match's header (the same body as nbl_rosetta_match): status, scores, venue, season and teams. Endpoint URL: GET https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/match/{match_id} Valid URL: https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/match/b217a699-4bef-11f0-bc08-933162362355
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

One match's official player box score, one row per player line (period 0 = whole game). Endpoint URL: GET https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/match/{match_id}/live/all Valid URL: https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/match/b217a699-4bef-11f0-bc08-933162362355/live/all
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

One match's team box score by period, one row per team and period (0 = whole game). Endpoint URL: GET https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/match/{match_id}/live/all Valid URL: https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/match/b217a699-4bef-11f0-bc08-933162362355/live/all
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

One match's player box score by period (Rosetta-computed from the event log), one row per player and period. Endpoint URL: GET https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/match/{match_id}/live/all Valid URL: https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/match/b217a699-4bef-11f0-bc08-933162362355/live/all
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

One match's play-by-play with shot x/y, oldest first (NBL 2025-26 included, which ESPN's nbl feed lacks). Endpoint URL: GET https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/match/{match_id}/live/all Valid URL: https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/match/b217a699-4bef-11f0-bc08-933162362355/live/all
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

The organisation's next scheduled match (empty between seasons). Endpoint URL: GET https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/next/match/for/{org}/{season} Valid URL: https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/next/match/for/nbl/2027
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

Next match; the team segment is ignored by Rosetta (the body is the organisation's next match). Endpoint URL: GET https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/next/match/for/team/{team_code}/{org}/{season} Valid URL: https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/next/match/for/team/PER/nbl/2027
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.
nbl_rosetta_next_match_team(org='nbl', season=2027, team_code='PER') Last validated n/a.

Each team's next matches: opponent, venue and start time. Endpoint URL: GET https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/next/matches/for/teams/in/{org}/{season} Valid URL: https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/next/matches/for/teams/in/nbl/2027
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

Every season of an organisation: regular, preseason, in-season cups and test seasons, with dates. Endpoint URL: GET https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/{org}/seasons Valid URL: https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/nbl/seasons
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.
